svg.text: Algorithm C.4. Combined Retrieval with Hard Category and TF-IDF
Input: image I; text T; catalog embeddings and TF-IDF index; result count K
Output: ranked products from the selected category
1 Encode I and T with the fine-tuned CLIP encoders.
2 Compute S_II(q,p_i), S_TI(q,p_i), and available S_TT(q,p_i).
3 Fuse CLIP scores with the validation-selected text and image weights.
4 Detect exact catalog-category expressions in T.
5 If exactly one category is stated, use that category.
6 Otherwise, predict one category from I using Algorithm C.2 evidence.
7 Keep only products in the selected category and optional audience group.
8 Remove recognized category words from the TF-IDF refinement query.
9 If usable metadata words remain, add gated TF-IDF similarity.
10 Rank eligible products by the resulting score and return the first K.
Note: Confidence is diagnostic; no dynamic relation bonus is added.
